summary.text: Scott Singer is the Republican nominee. A Boca Raton attorney and small-business owner, he was elected to the Boca Raton City Council in 2014 and served as the city's mayor from 2018 to 2026. He describes himself as an "America First Republican" running on lower taxes, border security and cutting regulation.

paragraphs.text: Born in Miami Beach and raised in Fort Lauderdale, according to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey; he also says he is raising his family in the 25th District.

Graduated from Pine Crest School, earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University (1998) and a law degree from Georgetown Law (2003). The Florida League of Mayors says he graduated cum laude with a degree in government.
Has worked for two decades as a business attorney and small-business owner; the Florida League of Mayors says he owns several small businesses, including a law firm focused on entrepreneurs.
Was first elected to the Boca Raton City Council in 2014 and re-elected in 2017; the council appointed him deputy mayor.

Became Mayor of Boca Raton on April 27, 2018, and served until 2026. In his survey, he says that as mayor he cut tax rates seven straight times and led 21 streamlining initiatives to reduce regulation.
Is a fellow at the America First Policy Institute and chairs its America First Mayors' Council, according to Ballotpedia and his survey.
